ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels covering approximately 95% of the visible surface; high-intensity pixels (white) are restricted to small, isolated clusters and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity dark field across both lobes. High-intensity multi-color clusters (tan, white, red) are localized at the distal-most coordinates of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the full length of the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels create a distinct sawtooth profile relative to the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lateral sweep following an upward-convex curve on the trailing edge boundary, tapering significantly as it reaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several discrete, circular high-contrast white clusters (approximately 4-6 identifiable points) located on the inner lobe surfaces proximal to the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, irregular clusters of textured, high-contrast pixels (white, brown, and reddish-pink tones) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, indicating significant biological encrustation.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, high-contrast thin white circular ring (potential water artifact or annular scar) is visible on the medial-posterior region of the right lobe surface.
